Metadata.description: Track jobs, your applications and your profile.

Nav.installIos: To install: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".

Auth.logInIntro: Track jobs, your applications and your profile.
Auth.signUpIntro: Find jobs, tailor your resume and track your applications.
Auth.name: Name
Auth.signupClosed: Sign-up is closed on this server right now. Ask the admin if you need an account.
Auth.needsInvite: Sign-up on this server is by invite only. Ask the admin for an invite link.
Auth.inviteInvalid: This invite link has expired, was used up or was canceled. Ask the admin for a new one.

personal.heading: Personal details
personal.intro: What forms ask about you. Your first and last name also become your account name, used on resumes and letters.
personal.genderHint: Only for forms that ask. Never put on resumes.

about.heading: About you
about.headline: Headline
about.headlineHint: One line, like “Frontend engineer who loves design systems”
about.languagesHint: With your real level, e.g. German A2, English C1. Resumes copy it exactly.
about.keywordsHint: Words from job ads that are true for you. ✓ on the Fit tab adds them here.

answers.heading: Application answers
answers.intro: What every application form asks. The Apply kit gives these to {ai} for the cover letter and to Claude in Chrome to fill in forms, exactly as you write them here. Leave out anything you don’t want shared.
answers.addressHint: City and country, or the full address forms ask for
answers.workPermitHint: e.g. EU Blue Card, or no visa needed in the EU
answers.notesHint: Short answers you reuse, like why you are looking for a new job. {ai} adapts them to each job.

custom.heading: Your own fields
custom.intro: Anything else forms ask, like Xing, pronouns or a portfolio. The Apply kit passes them on as you write them.
custom.name: Field {n} name

resume.heading: Master resume
resume.intro: Upload your resume here. You edit it section by section in the Resume builder. Match scores and tailored resumes start from it.
resume.languageHint: Jobs in this language are checked against it. Add other languages on the right.
resume.upload: Upload a PDF or Word file
resume.uploadHint: Up to 5 MB. Scanned images can’t be read.
resume.read: Resume read. Open the Resume builder to check the sections.
resume.achievementsHint: One true fact per line, with real numbers. {ai} may use them in any tailored resume, and the fact check trusts them.
resume.achievementsExample:
Cut page load time by 40% at Acme (2023)
Led a team of 4 developers on the checkout redesign
resume.maxPagesHint: {ai} keeps each tailored resume to this length. The PDF check uses it too.
resume.keepSectionsHint: Every section of my resume stays, with my own names and order (Key Highlights, Achievements, Technical Skills…), and every job keeps its projects. {ai} only tailors what is inside.

errors.years: Years of experience must be between 0 and 60
errors.fieldsMax: Add at most 30 fields of your own

other.heading: Resume in other languages
other.intro: Optional. Jobs whose ad is in one of these languages are checked against that resume, and the {ai} prompt starts from it. Your master resume stays the main one.
other.savedNote: ✓ Your {language} resume is saved. Jobs in {language} now use it.
other.savedNoteFile: ✓ Your {language} resume is saved (read from {file}). Jobs in {language} now use it.
other.noResume: No {language} resume yet? Let {ai} translate your master resume. The prompt keeps every employer, date and number, and your real language levels.
other.copied: Copied. Paste it into {ai}, then paste {ai}’s answer below.
other.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the prompt below instead.
other.uploadSaves: Uploading a file saves it straight away: no need to click Save.
other.addFirst: Add a resume in another language

suggestions.title: Suggestions for your resume
suggestions.allGood: Your resume looks good. No quick fixes found.
suggestions.LEVEL: Language level differs from My profile ({detail}). Use your real level everywhere.
suggestions.WORK_PERMIT: Your resume mentions “{detail}”. Add it under Applications > Work permit so tailored resumes keep it.
suggestions.DATES: Long dashes in dates ({detail}). Some ATS misread them: write 08/2022 - 05/2026.
suggestions.CLICHES: Generic words recruiters skip: {detail}. Show it with an example instead.
suggestions.SYMBOLS: Symbols an ATS may not read: {detail}
suggestions.NUMBERS: Only {with} of {bullets} bullets have a number. Add results (time saved, scale, team size) where you have them.
suggestions.LENGTH: About {pages} pages ({words} words), more than your limit of {limit}. Tailored resumes will be cut to {limit}, or raise the page limit.
suggestions.ACHIEVEMENTS: Your resume has {count, plural, one {# achievement} other {# achievements}}. Put them in the Achievements bank so every tailored resume can use them.
suggestions.askClaudeHint: Paste it into {ai}: it reviews your resume like a recruiter and lists the top fixes.
suggestions.count: {count, plural, =0 {No quick fixes} one {# suggestion} other {# suggestions}}
suggestions.open: Show the suggestions for your resume

claudeAnswers.heading: Answers for {ai}
claudeAnswers.intro: Your answers to {ai}’s questions, kept for the next job. Edit or delete any.
claudeAnswers.fill: Fill in my saved answers by themselves
claudeAnswers.stretches: Show Stretches (lines that may be hard to explain)
claudeAnswers.none: No saved answers yet. Answer one of {ai}’s questions on a job and it shows up here.

stories.title: Story bank
stories.intro: True stories for interviews, in STAR form: situation, task, action, result. Interview prep gives Claude the ones that fit each job, for "Tell me about a time…" answers.
stories.empty: No stories yet. Add one you would tell in an interview: a problem you solved, a project you led, a mistake you learned from.
stories.titleExample: e.g. Cut the nightly data load from 4 hours to 40 minutes

hints.situation: Where were you, what was going on?
hints.task: What did you have to do?
hints.action: What did you do, step by step?
hints.result: What came of it? Real numbers only.
hints.reflection: Optional: what you learned or would do differently

stories.tagsExample: e.g. SQL, Airflow, leadership (separate with commas)

chips.heading: Skills and keywords
chips.intro: Used for Fit % and for tailoring your resume.
chips.copyHint: Your resume does not mention these. Copy them, and add the ones that are true to your resume.

keys.heading: API keys
keys.intro: Your own keys for paid services, so you spend your own credits. They are stored encrypted and never shown again once saved.

jobhunter.name: JobHunter token
jobhunter.hint: Used when you import jobs from JobHunter or your saved searches run.
jobhunter.testHint: Test runs a search for one job, which costs at most 1 credit.

keys.credits: {count, plural, one {1 credit left} other {# credits left}}
keys.confirmDelete: Delete this key? Imports stop until you add one again.

ai.heading: AI
ai.intro: Pick your AI and paste its key. The AI score (Resume-Matcher) uses your key and credits, and the copy-and-open buttons open this AI's chat.

hint.ANTHROPIC: Create one at console.anthropic.com (Settings > API keys).

ai.testHint: Test lists the provider's models: free, and it checks that your model exists.
ai.confirmDelete: Delete this key? The AI score stops until you add one again.

pool.ask: Ask the admin. You get a key from the shared pool when one is free.
pool.emptyTitle: No keys are free right now.
pool.emptyText: You can still ask and join the waiting list. Until then: use your own key, or the Arbeitsagentur and company boards (no token needed).
pool.waitingText: Sent {when}. You get a bell as soon as it is decided.
pool.ownCancels: If you save your own token, the request is cancelled for you.
pool.approvedText: Already set, nothing to do. Imports and saved searches use it now. Please use it with care, the pool is shared.
pool.giveBackHint: Give back · You can add your own token any time below, it replaces this one.
pool.freeSources: Arbeitsagentur and company boards need no token.

notify.heading: Notifications
notify.newMatches: Tell me when a scheduled search finds new jobs that fit me
notify.newMatchesHint: You get a 🔔 notification with the best jobs and a link to each.
notify.fitMinHint: Its Fit % must be at least this.
notify.interviewHint: Always on: the 🔔 reminds you the day before an interview date you entered in a job's Interview tab.

mail.title: Email
mail.intro: Connect your Gmail accounts and the app reads employer replies, then suggests moves on your tracker (a rejection, an interview invitation, an offer). You approve each one.
mail.loadFailed: Could not load your email accounts: {error}
mail.notConfigured: Gmail is not set up on this server yet. Add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET to your .env file (see the README).
mail.notAvailable: Gmail is not available on this server yet.
mail.privacy: Read-only: the app can never send, change or delete your mail. It looks at the last two weeks, once an hour, and keeps only the sender, subject and a short snippet of mails that match a job you applied to. Disconnect any time.

result.denied: You did not allow access, so nothing was connected.
result.error: Connecting Gmail did not work. Please try again.
result.not-configured: Gmail is not set up on this server yet.

matcher.intro: Scores each job against your resume (ATS score) and writes a tailored version.
matcher.testHint: Sends one tiny message to your AI through Resume-Matcher, with your key.
matcher.sending: Sending… Resume-Matcher’s AI is reading your resume, which can take a minute.

status.off: Resume-Matcher is switched off: set RESUME_MATCHER_URL in .env.
status.unavailable: Resume-Matcher is not available right now. Please try again later.
status.down: Resume-Matcher doesn't answer. Start it with pnpm rm:up.
status.noKey: Resume-Matcher is running, but you have no AI key yet. Add one under Settings › API keys.
status.aiFailed: Resume-Matcher is running, but {provider} ({model}) did not answer: check the key, model and credits.

resume.NO_FILE: Upload your resume as a PDF or Word file on the Resume page so Resume-Matcher can use it.
resume.NOT_SENT: Your resume hasn't been sent to Resume-Matcher yet.
resume.OUTDATED: You uploaded a newer resume. Send it again so jobs are matched against it.
resume.READY: Resume-Matcher has read {file}. Jobs will be matched against it.
resume.FAILED: Resume-Matcher got the file, but its AI couldn't read it. Check the key with Test AI connection, then send it again.

Resume.title: Resume builder
Resume.intro: Drag the grip to reorder. Changes save on their own; the PDF on the right updates after each save.
Resume.downloadWait: Wait until your changes are saved
Resume.name: Name
Resume.headline: Headline
Resume.contactBreakHint: Starts a new line in the PDF header here. Put your languages or work permit on a second line.
Resume.hideSection: Hide {title} from the PDF and prompts
Resume.languagesLocked: Your languages always come from My profile with your real levels, so a resume never claims more.
Resume.tooLong: Longer than your page limit of {max}. Hide a section or shorten some bullets.
Resume.letterTooLong: Your cover letter is longer than {max, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}. Shorten it.
Resume.noLetterYet: Write your letter to see the PDF
Resume.plainPreview: This is the plain PDF. Start the PDF box (pnpm pdf:up) to see your template here.
Resume.plainPreviewUser: This is the plain PDF. Your template shows here again when PDF templates are back.

improve.title: Improve this section with AI
improve.hint: Same facts, better words. You see the changes first and keep or discard them. Nothing is added that is not in your resume, your profile or your achievements.
improve.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Allow clipboard access and try again.
improve.withKeyHint: Uses your own AI key and its credits
improve.noKey: Add an AI key in Settings to use this
improve.flagged: {count, plural, one {# thing is} other {# things are}} not in anything you told us. Check before you keep it:
improve.flaggedHint: Keep it only if it is true. Otherwise discard, or keep and delete the line.
improve.factsOk: Every number, skill and level is already in your resume or profile.

check.title: Check this resume
check.noFacts: Nothing to compare with yet. Save your master resume first.
check.factsOk: Every number, skill and level is in your master resume or profile.
check.factsHint: In this resume but in nothing you told us. Keep each only if it is true:

letter.title: Cover letter
letter.hint: Start with the greeting and end with the sign-off and your name. The PDF adds your address, the date, the company and the subject line.
letter.empty: No cover letter for this job yet. Write one with AI, or add the first paragraph yourself.
letter.writeTitle: Write a cover letter with AI
letter.improveTitle: Improve this cover letter with AI
letter.aiHint: Same facts, better words. You see the new letter first and keep or discard it. Nothing is added that is not in your resume, your profile or your achievements.
letter.templateHint: Write it once; each job’s letter can start from it. Type '{company}' and '{job}' where the company and the job title go.
letter.templateEmpty: No template yet. Add the first paragraph: start with the greeting and end with the sign-off and your name.

readAgain.outOfDate: Your resume file changed (a new upload?). Read it into sections again, or keep the builder’s version?
readAgain.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Allow clipboard access and try again.
readAgain.title: Sort my resume with my AI chat
readAgain.confirm: This replaces what you see here. Undo brings it back.
readAgain.clipboardFailed: Couldn’t read the clipboard. Paste into the box with Ctrl+V.
readAgain.stepHint: Your AI chat sorts jobs, dates and bullets into the right places without changing a word.
readAgain.aboutTitle: About sorting with your AI chat
readAgain.applied: Done: your resume is sorted. Undo brings the old one back.

look.rendererOff: The PDF renderer isn’t running, so downloads are plain PDFs for now. Start it with
look.rendererMissing: PDF templates are switched off: set PDF_RENDERER_URL in .env, then start the renderer with
look.rendererUnavailable: PDF templates are not available right now, so downloads are plain PDFs for now.
look.wordColours: Your Word file keeps its own colours and fonts; these are for the cover letter.
look.showPhoto: Show my photo on the resume
look.photoHint: JPEG or PNG, up to 2 MB. Common in Germany, optional elsewhere.
look.wordUnusable: {file} can’t be used as a template yet.
look.wordUses: My own Word file uses {file}: everything above your first heading stays as it is, and each section is written in the style of yours (found: {sections}).
look.wordPdf: Step 3 of the Apply kit then offers a Word download you can edit. The PDF is made with LibreOffice, which may swap a font it doesn’t have; for an exact PDF, open the Word file and save it as PDF.
look.myDesignIntro: Use the look of your own resume, rebuilt in LaTeX as one clean column that applicant tracking systems read.
look.myDesignStep1: Copy the prompt. {ai} opens in a new tab.
look.myDesignStep2: Attach your resume file (PDF, Word or a screenshot) in {ai} and send the prompt.
look.myDesignStep3: Paste {ai}’s reply below and save. “My design” becomes your default template.
look.myDesignCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the prompt here instead.
look.myDesignTook: What My design took from your resume
look.myDesignTwoColumns: Your resume has two columns. My design puts everything in one column, because applicant tracking systems read two columns in the wrong order.
look.intro: How your resume and cover letter PDFs look. Every change shows in the PDF on the right and is used for every job.
look.spacingHint: For your resume. Make the text smaller or the margins narrower to fit your page limit.
look.compact: Compact: less space between jobs and bullets

skills.label: Skills lines
skills.indexHint: Bold label, then the list in one aligned column
skills.linesHint: Bold label, then the list flowing on
skills.plainHint: Exactly as you typed the lines

headings.label: Section titles
headings.barHint: Small coloured bar before the title

dates.label: Dates
dates.rightHint: Dates on the right of the job title
dates.belowHint: Dates on a line under the job title

look.wordSpacing: Your Word file keeps its own size and spacing.
look.wordNone: Want your own layout? Upload your master resume as a Word (.docx) file in the Setup tab, and “My own Word file” appears here.
look.templateUsed: Your next PDF downloads use it.

Resume.copyToMasterHint: Put this section into your master resume, so it is the same for every job

job.noCopy: You have no resume for this job yet. Start one from your master resume: it is a copy, so changes here never touch your master unless you copy a section back.
job.start: Start a copy for this job
job.copyNote: This is a copy for this job. Your master resume stays as it is.
job.resetConfirm: Throw away the changes for this job and start again from your master resume?

match.title: Job match
match.fit: Fit score of the saved copy
match.fitHint: The score is for the saved copy; the lists below follow what you type.
match.noTerms: This job has no skills or keywords to check.
match.missingHint: Tick ✓ only when it is true: then it counts as yours and you can add it.
match.ready: You have it, not in the resume
match.readyHint: Drag one onto a line, or add it to Skills.
match.noAchievements: Add true facts with numbers on My profile › Achievements and they show up here.
match.achievementsHint: True lines from your achievements bank. Add one to your latest job.

format.label: Format text
format.hint: Select text, then format it. Ctrl+B and Ctrl+I work too.
format.hintIdle: Click in a field to format its text.

files.achievementsIntro: True facts with real numbers, one per line. The AI may use them in a tailored resume, the fact check trusts them, and Job match offers them as bullets.
files.copiedToBank: Copied to your Achievements bank and saved.

switcher.label: Resume
switcher.addLanguage: + Add a resume in another language

downloadStep.title: Download your resume
downloadStep.intro: The PDF looks exactly like the preview. To tailor it for a job, open the job and start a copy.

templatePage.heading: Cover letter template
templatePage.intro: Your usual letter. On a job’s Cover letter step, “Start from my template” fills it in with that job’s company and title.

skillRows.found: {count, plural, one {# bullet looks} other {# bullets look}} like “Label: list”.

Jobs.title: My Jobs
Jobs.intro: Search, filter and track the jobs you imported. Click a title for details.
Jobs.hiddenIntro: Only you don’t see these. Unhide a job to put it back in your table, or click “All jobs” to go back.

undo.hidMany: Hid {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}}.
undo.backMany: Brought back {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}}.

errors.queue: Could not add to the Apply queue: {error}

Jobs.allTracked: All your jobs are on the Tracker now. Find more on the “Job Market” page.

empty.title: No jobs yet
empty.text: Import jobs from JobHunter, the Arbeitsagentur or company career pages, or add one by hand.

format.estimatedLevelHint: Estimated from the ad’s words: Grundkenntnisse ≈ A2, gut ≈ B2, fließend or verhandlungssicher ≈ C1, Muttersprache ≈ C2

cards.label: Show jobs by status
cards.newHint: Jobs imported since your last visit

toolbar.active: {count, plural, one {# filter active} other {# filters active}}

row.fitEmpty: Add your resume on the Resume page to see how well you fit each job
row.fitHint: How much of the job’s skills, keywords and title your resume covers. Click for details

row.selectAll: Select all jobs on this page
row.expiredHint: The ad is closed (found by the still-open check or the job board)
row.matchHint: AI matcher (Resume-Matcher) score for your resume. Click for details

queue.moveDownHint: Move down: apply for it later
queue.copyPrompt: Copy prompt for Claude in Chrome

popup.minimizeHint: Minimize: keep it in a small bar at the bottom and open it again later

popup.noDescription: This job has no description, so there is nothing to match.
popup.removeQueue: Click to remove from the Apply queue
popup.addQueueHint: Apply to several jobs later in one go
popup.pdfProblem: The resume PDF has something to fix
popup.fitPillHint: Free: our own keyword check of your master resume against this ad. No AI.
popup.fitTabHint: Free: our own keyword check. No AI, no cost.
popup.matchTabHint: Resume-Matcher scores your master resume with your own AI key. Costs a few cents.

ad.youHave: You have it: on your profile’s Skills list

interview.gapsHint: Skills the ad asks for that your resume doesn’t show. The prompt asks {ai} for an honest answer to each.
interview.noGaps: Your resume covers every skill the ad asks for.
interview.noResume: Add your resume on the Resume page to see which skills the interviewer may ask about.
interview.german: The ad asks for German {level}. Practise your answers in German, at your real level.
interview.germanAny: The ad asks for German. Practise your answers in German, at your real level.

interview.blocked: The browser blocked reading the clipboard. Paste the reply in the box instead.

interview.gapJumpHint: Show what to say about it
interview.pasteInBox: or paste it in a box

prep.noAnswer: {ai} gave no model answer for this one.

mock.intro: {ai} plays the interviewer: one question at a time, with feedback after each answer and a score at the end. Try it in {ai}’s voice mode to practise speaking.
mock.copiedHint: {ai} opened in a new tab: paste it there (Ctrl+V) and answer its questions.

date.title: Interview date
date.label: Interview date and time
date.reminder: Reminder in the bell 1 day before
date.hint: Saving moves the job to Interviewing. The bell reminds you a day before.

fit.removeHint: I don’t have it: remove from this job

languages.customHint: Edited for this job only. Reset goes back to your profile’s Languages.

message.title: I built this for my own job search
message.p1: Looking for a job meant many sites, many ads and a new resume for each one. So I made one place that does it all for me.
message.p2: Now I'm glad to share it with you. I hope it makes your path to the next job a little easier.
message.sign: Good luck with your search, Mohamed Faizel
message.photoAlt: Mohamed Faizel at his desk with a laptop

hero.eyebrow: Job search for Germany and beyond
hero.lead: Job Search Hunter puts jobs from the Arbeitsagentur, company career pages and JobHunter into one list. It shows how well each job fits your resume and helps you apply in English or German.
hero.fine: Sign up with your email. It takes about a minute, and your account comes with 500 JobHunter credits.
hero.shotAlt: My Jobs: a table of jobs with fit scores, places and status

how.title: How it works
how.sub: Three steps, the same every day.
how.s1: Pick where to look, type a job title and import. New jobs land in My Jobs with a New badge.
how.s2: See your Fit score and the skills you're missing. Claude writes your resume, cover letter and form answers. You check them and send.
how.s3: Move each job on your board. Gmail spots replies and suggests the next step.

unique.title: What makes it different
unique.sub: Most job sites stop at a list of ads. Job Search Hunter keeps working for you after that.
unique.u1: Each job shows the skills and keywords your resume is missing. Tick the ones you really have and they are saved to your profile, so they count for every job after that.
unique.u1Alt: Fit tab with missing skills and keywords
unique.u2: The job popup marks seniority, remote or on-site, salary, visa support and the ad's language. It also warns you about scams and reposted ads.
unique.u2Alt: Job popup warning that an ad may be a scam
unique.u3: Save a search and let it run on a schedule. The bell tells you when new jobs that fit you arrive, on the web and on your phone.
unique.u3Alt: Notification: new jobs that fit you from a saved search
unique.u4: The Salary tab compares the pay with similar jobs in the same country and gives you ready lines for the salary talk.
unique.u4Alt: Salary tab comparing the pay with similar jobs

sourceList.title: Live jobs from 40+ sources
sourceList.sub: The Arbeitsagentur and company career pages are built in. Every new account also gets 500 JobHunter credits, so you can search all of these live from day one:

features.market1: Search the Arbeitsagentur, company career pages and JobHunter from one form.
features.market2: Save a search and run it again on a schedule.
features.market3: Skip titles you don't want, like Werkstudent or Praktikum.
features.marketAlt: Job Market form with three sources
features.apply1: Fit score shows which skills and keywords your resume is missing.
features.apply2: Claude writes a resume, cover letter and answers for this one job, using your own AI key.
features.apply3: Put many jobs in the Apply queue and work through them in one go.
features.applyAlt: Job popup on the Apply tab
features.resumeTitle: A clean PDF resume in one click
features.resume1: 10 designs. Pick colour, size and spacing.
features.resume2: Keep an English and a German resume side by side.
features.resume3: Your language levels stay exactly as you set them.
features.resumeAlt: Four resume PDF designs side by side
features.tracker1: Drag cards from Saved to Applied, Interview and Offer.
features.tracker2: Your funnel shows how many get an answer and how long it takes.
features.tracker3: Connect Gmail and the app suggests the right status for each reply.

trust.title: Your data stays yours
trust.t1: Your jobs, resume and board are private. Admins only see counts.

about.title: One person's job search, now shared with everyone
about.lead: Job Search Hunter started as a tool I built for myself. Today anyone can use it to find jobs, apply with help and keep track.
about.s1: Looking for a job meant many websites, many ads and a new resume for each one. It was easy to lose track of where I had applied.
about.s2: One place that brings the jobs together, shows how well each one fits, helps write the application and keeps track of every answer.
about.s3: It made my own search easier. I hope it does the same for you, wherever you are looking.
about.v1: Only you see your jobs, resume and board. Admins only see counts.
about.v2: Claude writes a draft. You check every word before anything is sent.
about.v3: The app warns you about scams and old, reposted ads.
about.v4: The whole app works in English and German, and so do your resumes.
about.builtSub: For anyone who is curious about the technology.
